verdict.rationale: Numeral automates certain backend processes (autofiling, nexus monitoring, alerts) but there is no evidence of an API, MCP tool, or agent-facing mechanism that lets an AI-native user configure or schedule recurring jobs/workflows themselves — the MCP server (numeral-docs-7, numeral-docs-30) only exposes query/read tools like nexus status and filings, not job scheduling. Missing for 10: any documented scheduling/cron API, recurring workflow configuration via MCP/agent, or automation-trigger endpoints.
